```yaml
name: Maintenance – Consolidate Agentic Workflow Discussions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  consolidate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Update discussion categories
        id: update
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          # Find markdown files that contain the old categories
          files=$(git ls-files '*.md' | grep -E 'audit-workflows\.md|portfolio-analyst\.md')
          if [ -z "$files" ]; then
            echo "No target files found."
            exit 0
          fi

          for file in $files; do
            echo "Processing $file"
            # Replace category: "q-a" or category: Audits with category: "agentic-workflows"
            sed -i -E 's/(category:\s*)(["']?)(q-a|Audits)(["']?)/\1"agentic-workflows"/' "$file"
          done

          # Commit changes if any
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes made."
            exit 0
          fi

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add $files
          git commit -m "chore: update discussion categories to agentic-workflows"
          git push
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Report status
        if: steps.update.outcome == 'success'
        run: echo "Discussion categories updated successfully."
```
